Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Master Touch kettle as I just got into charcoal barbecue and it is fantastic. It comes with everything you need to get started. Easy to assemble and use. Photos.Caption: Our new Weber looks great on our patio!

Results.ReviewText:
After reading a lot of charcoal grill reviews online and looking at my options at local stores, I decided to return to the original and I went with this classic Weber 22" grill.  I really love the grill - it's basic, but Weber has perfected their design over the years.  It is much easier to clean out and control the heat than with my previous grill from the other guys.  The classic Weber design has been around so long, it is easy to pickup accessories and replacement parts.  With other brands, one thing breaks, and it's impossible to get parts because they only made that model for 2 months. 
 I love the Ocean Blue color of this Weber that I got.  It coordinates well with the rest of our backyard patio.  So far, I am a huge fan!
Results.Title: Go with the Original Weber!

Results.ReviewText:
I love kettle Webers, I always have. There has been a kettle Weber in my life since as long as I can remember. This one is just as good, and maybe even better. The gates are thicker, the ash collection system is superior, and the cooking heat is as reliable as ever. I do like the lid holder on this version, but wish i could adjust it to sit just a little further back.

I will try to use this as a smoker soon, and we'll really see what we've got; but as a grill you really can't go wrong. 

All hail Weber, long live the kettle!

Results.ReviewText:
This is a highly versatile charcoal bbq. It absolutely slays any meat you decide to grill/sear/smoke. This is my 4th Weber grill. (18in base kettle x7 years, 18in Smokey mountain x3 years, Weber Spirit II propane grill x1 year, 22in Master touch kettle) all have been very solid and serviceable. This smokes just as good as the Smokey Mountain and way better than the pellet grill I replaced with this kettle. Don’t be fooled by the pellet grills; charcoal and wood chunks create a far superior smokey flavor on your meat. Best tri-tip and pulled pork in my life came off this kettle. I only have two negatives. I wish the center grate for the Gourmet accessories stayed in place when I took the grill off as opposed to falling out every time I try to refill my charcoal on a new grill/smoke. Additionally I installed a secondary grill lid thermometer on the vent side of the lid so I can get a better reading of temperature where my meat is located (vent over meat) when I do indirect grilling/smoking.
The bottom line is Weber Has been making this style of grill for over 70 years now and the recipe really hasn’t changed too much because when you start off with something that’s near perfect, there’s not much more you can do to make it better. This really can do it all. Thanks Weber for making fantastic quality grills at an obtainable price point. When you hear charcoal grill, you think Weber kettle.
Results.Title: Master touch is all you need. No more pellet grill

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
